Indian Standard
DIMENSIONS FOR PORECLAIN TRANSFORMER BUSHINGS FOR USE IN NORMAL AND LIGHTLY POLLUTED ATMOSPHERES PART v 36 kV BUSHINGS
Section 1 Porcelain Parts

(Second Revision)
o.
FOR E W 0 R D
0.1 This Indian Standard (Part V jSec 1 ) (Second Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 21 September 1979, after the draft finalized by the Electrical Insulators and Accessories Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 This part ( Part V ) of the standard covers dimensions of porcelain
transformer bushings for use in normal and lightly polluted atmospheres of 36 kV with the object of ensuring their interchangeability. To avoid multiplicity of sizes, the dimensions given are only for those ratings (voltage and current) which are being used appreciably. This part comprises two sections issued as two separate standards. While this section ( Sec 1 ) covers the porcelain parts of the bushings, the dimensions of the metal parts to go with these procelain parts are specified in the other section of IS : 3347 ( Part VjSec 2 ) - 1979*.

0.3 This standard ( Part VjSec I ) was first issued in 1965. The first
revision was taken up in 1973 with a view to simplify the manufacture of the porcelain parts on large scale by permitting an alternative shape of their top petticoat in respect of all the ratings covered in this standard. This second revision has been undertaken to include dimensions of 2000 A, and 3 150 A bushings.

0.4 The dimensions given in this standard have been arrived at after full
consideration of the available sizes and an examination of the relevant merits of different types of bushings. Detailed dimensions have vbeen given with a view to achieving maximum economy in the manufacture of the bushings.
*Dimesions for porcelain transformer bushings for use in normal and lightly polluted atmospheres: PMt V 36 kV bushings, Section :.1 Metal parts.

bushings used outdoor with inner ends immersed in oil and suitable .for use in normal and lightly pol1uted atmospheres.

0.10 In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards issued by the Deutscher Norrnenausschuss: DIN 42531 (1968) Transformatoren; Durchfuhrungen fur Innenraum.und Freiluft, Reihen 10 N bis 30 N, 250 A ( Indoor and outdoor transformer bushings: Insulation class ION to 30 N, 250 A). DIN 42532 (1969) Transformatoren; Durchfuhrungen fur Innenraum und Freiluft, Reihen 10 N bis 30 N, 630 A ( Indoor and outdoor transformer bushings: Insulation class 10 N to 30 N, 630 A). DIN 42533 (1969) Transformatoren; Durchfuhrungen fur Innenrauni und Freiluft, Reihen 10 N bis 30 N; '1 000 bis 3 150 A ( Indoor and outdoor transformer bushings: Insulation class 10 N to 30 N, 1 (l00 to 3 150 A ). 0.11 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960.... The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard (Part V jSec 1 ) lays down the dimensions of the porcelain parts of the bushings of 36 kV used with transformers for use in normal and lightly polluted atmospheres. 2. DIMENSIONS 2.1 The dimensions of the porcelain parts for different ratings ( kV/A ) of the bushings are given in Fig. 1, 2 and 3. 2.2 Unless specified otherwise, tolerance on a dimension shall be �( 0'03 d 0'3 ) mm, d being the dimension in millimetres,
